I also need to confirm the coordinates again. The latest sources from Wikipedia and other sites consistently give the same coordinates for San Luis Obispo's Bubblegum Alley. That gives me confidence in the location.

So, putting it all together, the primary location is Bubblegum Alley in downtown San Luis Obispo, CA, at 733 Higuera Street, with coordinates around 35.2790 N, -120.6638 W. There don't seem to be other Bubblegum Alleys in California based on the searches I conducted.
